items.lyrics:
I watch the sun rise past the hill
The pale light warms the roof at dawn
My small boat rocks on waves of gold
We sail back home and sing once more

The rain falls soft on leaves of green
I hear each drop tap on the glass
Your coat hangs near the old front door
Come sit with me till clouds drift past

We walk where tall reeds touch the stream
The wind bends each thin stem in turn
A white bird lifts its wings and flies
I hold this day and let it burn

The train rolls out past fields of wheat
Its low hum keeps a slow warm beat
My hand rests on the cold grey pane
One day this road leads home once more

I plant one seed in soft dark earth
The spring rain wakes its roots at night
A small green shoot breaks through the ground
We lift its leaves up to the light

The moon hangs low right past the bay
We count the lights that line the shore
Your voice floats through the cool salt air
I turn and hear that tune once more

The snow lies deep on roof and road
My boots leave marks near to the gate
A red scarf moves through all the white
Your lamp is on and I can wait

We pass the shops and cross the square
The bells call out the time at noon
You tap your heel and take my hand
We hum one verse then change the tune

A kite pulls hard on one thin string
The blue sky fills its broad red sail
I run with you right through the field
We laugh and chase its long white tail

The stars shine through the bare black trees
Their light falls on the path like rain
I hear your steps right by my own
We find the way back home once more

The bread is warm the tea is sweet
We share the last red plum at dawn
A small wren sings near to the door
Its song stays close when you are gone

The tide draws lines right through the sand
A shell lies where the waves have been
We leave two stones next to the path
And trust the sea to sing once more
